text:
Rafiq Omar: FYI -- Meridian wants to cut over from HaloAPI to Redwood. They're asking for a 4-week proof-of-concept (POC) focused on connector compatibility, prompt/response parity, and an initial migration cost delta. Main enterprise asks: KMS BYOK, 12mo audit logs, and their legal needs our DPA before pushing sample logs. SEs + infra pls.
June Park: I'll lead SE. Plan: 1) build 60-prompt suite covering summarization, formalization, and troubleshooting; 2) run A/B against their Halo baseline; 3) produce tokenized diffs + response-shape mapping (they rely on halo:entities & metadata). Need sample responses and clarify whether they use server-side conversation state.
Lena Torres: Finance note: Meridian projects ~1.2M tokens/month. For POC we'll offer $2k credit and model pay-as-you-go vs 6mo reserved. Halo rounds to 25-50 token buckets which will inflate short-turn costs; we'll show both models.
Arjun Menon: Ops ask: need CIDR and contact window. We can provision a dedicated devpool and static egress IPs. For BYOK in hosted POC we'll support envelope encryption with their public key; full KMS integration requires Private deployment + SOW.
clark-ops: devpool request created: meridian-poc -> devpool-11. Reserved egress IPs: 3.98.44.200 - 3.98.44.203. Peering window requested: 03/28 01:00-03:00 UTC.
security-bot: Sent security packet: SOC2 summary, DPA template, redacted pen-test. Meridian secops requested clarifications on key rotation and audit-log retention.
June Park: HaloAPI quirks: they sometimes include trailing newline and lowercase entity labels. We'll normalize shapes in the harness but flag any semantic mismatches. Also add temperature/stop-token instrumentation to mirror their config.
Rafiq Omar: Requesting sample traffic: 200 anonymized requests (can be synthetic) and three representative multi-turn threads. Legal sign-off pending; once DPA is back SE can ingest logs.
Lena Torres: Pricing scenarios uploaded to the sheet. Quick estimate after credits: ~$1.5k for 4 weeks assuming 600k tokens. Reserved 6mo reduces unit cost by ~15% at >3M tokens/mo.
Arjun Menon: Note: we should include a small compatibility shim doc for their devs showing how to map halo:entities -> redwood:entities and how we handle session tokens. I'll draft a short README and include example curl snippets.
June Park: Running initial diff now. Quick heads-up: expect minor tokenization deltas; call out any multi-turn semantic drifts. I'll share a CSV diff and a short heatmap by Fri EOD.
Rafiq Omar: Great. Next steps: SE run harness + post diff, Ops finalize peering, Security await DPA signature then supply docs, Finance finalize scenarios. Check-in Fri 11:00 PT. :calendar:
